messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (eu-west). Threshold exceeded for 5m. PagerDuty P12345 auto-pager fired.

sre-oncall: acknowledged via PagerDuty, I'm on it. assigning hotpath decode to jonathan.

jonathan: seeing p99 jump from ~420ms -> 2.1s, p95 ~360ms. spike started ~1712348600. traces point to tail tokenization + kv miss.

lee: ++ seeing KV cache miss rate jump to 78% and eviction churn high. recent infra change to eviction TTL at 60s?

arjun: rolling back the canary (model v2.1) to v2.0 now — pausing canaries and routing traffic back. doing a graceful drain.

sre-oncall: autoscaler shows no new nodes — hitting max replicas. triggering emergency scale to add 4 GPUs to eu-west pool: `kubectl scale deploy/model-runtime --replicas=22 -n prod-eu-west`. warming the new pods.

maria: adding temporary routing override to prefer dedicated-pool for high-cost requests to reduce noisy multi-tenant pressure. @product-ops FYI, no customer errors yet but interactive demos affected.

lee: warming top prefixes and firing targeted cache fills: `python tools/warm_kv.py --keys top200 --region eu-west`. starting now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty acknowledged by sre-oncall. Estimated mitigation ETA ~8m.

jonathan: p99 dropping — now ~1.3s, p95 still ~340ms. KV miss rate down to 41% after warms. continuing to monitor for 10m.

sre-oncall: keeping the emergency capacity for 30m, will scale down once p99 < 700ms sustained for 5m. preparing handoff notes and postmortem ticket.

maria: filing followup for eviction policy and batch size tuning. action items: investigate eviction TTL, reduce batch max_tokens for tail heavy workloads, and improve warmup on rollouts. :thumbsup:

product-ops: noted. will draft a brief customer bulletin if we need to extend maintenance window. :eyes:

jonathan: closing loop — will update when fully stable or if any regressions show.
